description: Create Outstanding Demand dashboard (new route /admin/outstanding) showing all requests with remaining demand > 0, display progress bars for partial fulfillment, add outstanding demand and critical shortage metrics to admin dashboard, and add 'Partially Fulfilled' filter to admin requests page
steps: 1. Add new route GET /admin/outstanding in app.py that queries all requests with (quantity - total_received) > 0, joins with locations, resources, and users tables, calculates days waiting using created_at, and passes data to outstanding.html template.

2. Create templates/outstanding.html with a table showing: location name, resource name, requested quantity, received quantity (total_received), remaining quantity (quantity - total_received), urgency pill, days waiting, and a visual progress bar showing percentage received (total_received / quantity * 100).

3. Add progress bar markup in outstanding.html using existing CSS classes:
where X = (total_received / quantity * 100). Include aria-label for accessibility.
4. Flag critical requests (urgency='Critical' AND days_waiting > 3) with a special visual indicator (red background or icon) in the outstanding table.
5. Add 'Outstanding Demand' as a navigation link in ADMIN_NAV list in app.py between 'Allocations' and 'Deliveries', using route name 'outstanding'.

6. Update admin_dashboard.html to add two new stat cards: 'Outstanding Demand' (count of requests with remaining > 0) and 'Critical Shortages' (count of critical requests waiting > 3 days). Use appropriate colors (orange for outstanding, red for critical).

7. Update admin_requests.html template: add 'Partially Fulfilled' to the status filter buttons, add a 'Remaining' column showing (quantity - total_received) with muted styling for 0 values, and modify the table to show total_received instead of or alongside allocated_qty.

8. Update my_requests.html template to show progress for the relief user: add a 'Received' column showing total_received, add a visual progress bar or percentage indicator, and update the status display to clearly show partial fulfillment.
acceptance_criteria: /admin/outstanding route exists and displays all requests with remaining demand > 0
Outstanding demand table shows location, resource, requested, received, remaining, urgency, days waiting, and progress bar
Critical requests (urgency=Critical AND waiting > 3 days) are visually flagged
Admin dashboard shows 'Outstanding Demand' and 'Critical Shortages' stat cards
Admin requests page has 'Partially Fulfilled' filter and shows remaining demand column
Relief user dashboard (my_requests.html) shows delivery progress with visual indicators
verification: Delete reliefgrid.db, run python app.py, login as admin
Apply an allocation that partially fulfills some requests (run out of stock)
Navigate to /admin/outstanding and verify all partially fulfilled requests appear with correct remaining quantities and progress bars
Check admin dashboard (/admin) and verify 'Outstanding Demand' stat shows correct count
Navigate to /admin/requests, click 'Partially Fulfilled' filter, verify filtered results
Login as relief user (riverside@ngo.org/relief123), navigate to /my/requests, verify progress indicators appear for partially fulfilled requests
